name: InventoryStatus
summary: Stock state chip for ecommerce / fulfillment surfaces. Five tones — in-stock, low-stock, backorder, preorder, sold-out. Each pairs a glyph + a label + the tone tint. Distinct from Badge (status pill, generic) — InventoryStatus encodes the standard commerce vocabulary so the Lumen library renders the same five tones across Shopify / BigCommerce / Woo surfaces.

quantity.description: Optional precise count: 'In stock — 4 left'. Renders only on low-stock by default.

compact.description: Icon-only chip with aria-label fallback. Use in tight cells / cards.

rules: Every status renders glyph + label. Color reinforces, never replaces.
compact mode requires aria-label spelling out the status.

do: Show low-stock quantity ('Only 4 left') — the threshold for urgency.
Sold-out is a danger tone; the CTA next to it should switch to 'Notify me'.
Preorder + backorder render in info tone with the ETA in nearby text.
dont: Don't paint in-stock in solid lime fill — accent green is reserved for actions. Use the success status pair (which uses a soft tint, not the accent stop).
Don't show quantity on in-stock above 10 — too precise hurts trust ('Why does it know 47?').
Don't suppress sold-out — surface it prominently.

changelog.note: Initial InventoryStatus contract. Five tones for commerce surfaces.
